error_example: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already
possible_causes: Connection limit reached; high concurrency; connection leaks; oversized app pools
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect pg_stat_activity; compare max_connections to app pool settings; check session cleanup

error_example: sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 5 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00
possible_causes: Pool checkout exhaustion; connections not returned; slow transactions; increased concurrency
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect session lifecycle, pool sizing, checkout durations and slow queries

error_example: psycopg.OperationalError: connection to server at "postgres" (172.18.0.2), port 5432 failed: Connection refused
possible_causes: Database process unavailable; wrong host/port; startup race; networking
general_diagnostic_steps: Confirm DB service health and endpoint; check startup and firewall; test connectivity

error_example: ERROR: deadlock detected (SQLSTATE 40P01)
possible_causes: Concurrent transactions lock rows in inconsistent order
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect involved queries and transaction locking order; shorten transactions; consider retry on deadlock

error_example: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "users_email_key" (SQLSTATE 23505)
possible_causes: Duplicate insert; race condition; uniqueness policy enforced
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect conflicting key, use upsert where appropriate, validate idempotency

error_example: GET /api/orders HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
possible_causes: App unavailable; upstream dependency failure; overload; health checks failing
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect app logs and health endpoints; check upstream and deployment changes

error_example: ERROR: Error loading ASGI app. Could not import module "app.main"
possible_causes: Wrong module path; missing dependency; invalid working directory
general_diagnostic_steps: Check launch command, PYTHONPATH, imports and environment

error_example: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named "pydantic_settings"
possible_causes: Dependency not installed in active environment; package renamed; wrong interpreter
general_diagnostic_steps: Verify virtual environment, requirements and python -m pip show

error_example: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error 111 connecting to redis:6379. Connection refused.
possible_causes: Redis down; wrong address; binding/firewall issue; startup race
general_diagnostic_steps: Check service health and host/port; verify network access and startup

error_example: OOM command not allowed when used memory > maxmemory
possible_causes: Redis memory cap reached; eviction policy disallows write; key growth
general_diagnostic_steps: Review used_memory, maxmemory, eviction policy and large keys

error_example: Back-off restarting failed container orders-api: CrashLoopBackOff
possible_causes: Process exits repeatedly; config error; missing dependency; probe failures
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect kubectl describe pod, previous container logs and exit codes

error_example: Container last terminated with reason OOMKilled, exitCode=137
possible_causes: Memory usage exceeded container limit; memory leak; traffic spike
general_diagnostic_steps: Check pod limits, memory metrics, heap profiles and deployment changes

error_example: Failed to pull image registry.example/orders:1.4.2: ImagePullBackOff
possible_causes: Missing image/tag; registry credentials; DNS/network issues
general_diagnostic_steps: Check image reference, imagePullSecrets and registry availability

error_example: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream; GET /api/orders 502
possible_causes: Backend crashed; proxy mismatch; upstream closed connection
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect upstream application logs and proxy settings; verify backend health

error_example: upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream; 504
possible_causes: Slow backend; blocked database; insufficient timeout; network issue
general_diagnostic_steps: Measure backend latency; inspect slow queries; review proxy timeouts

error_example: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests from upstream provider
possible_causes: Provider quota or rate limit; burst traffic; missing backoff
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect rate-limit headers, reduce concurrency, implement bounded retries with jitter

error_example: Upstream API returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable during inference request
possible_causes: Upstream service outage; transient overload; maintenance
general_diagnostic_steps: Check provider status and request IDs; retry with backoff within limits

error_example: ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: certificate verify failed: certificate has expired
possible_causes: Expired remote certificate; incorrect system time; broken chain
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect certificate validity and host; check system clock; renew certificate

error_example: socket.gaierror: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution
possible_causes: DNS resolver unavailable; invalid hostname; network policy
general_diagnostic_steps: Check hostname, DNS records, resolver configuration and network

error_example: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device: /var/log/app.log
possible_causes: Disk volume full; log growth; unbounded temporary files
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect disk/inodes and log rotation; clear space safely

error_example: PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: /app/uploads/report.pdf
possible_causes: File permissions; wrong runtime user; read-only mount
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect ownership, permissions and mount flags

error_example: qdrant_client.http.exceptions.ResponseHandlingException: [Errno 111] Connection refused to qdrant:6333
possible_causes: Qdrant unavailable; wrong endpoint; container/network failure
general_diagnostic_steps: Check Qdrant health, service address and network

error_example: Vector dimension error: expected dim: 768, got 1536
possible_causes: Embedding model dimension differs from Qdrant collection configuration
general_diagnostic_steps: Compare collection vector size and embedding model dimensions; recreate or migrate collection appropriately

error_example: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
possible_causes: Empty response; invalid JSON; unexpected HTML error page
general_diagnostic_steps: Check response status/content type and payload; handle parse errors

error_example: httpx.ReadTimeout: timed out while requesting https://api.example.test/v1/embed
possible_causes: Slow upstream; network congestion; timeout too short
general_diagnostic_steps: Inspect upstream latency and timeout policy; bounded retries
